original_test_intent: Verify the SUT can POST and boot with the approved full DIMM population and reports the expected slots, installed capacity and usable memory.
original_method: Qualified operator records baseline, powers down, installs or confirms the signed full-population map under ESD/service procedure, captures POST/BIOS, then the agent securely collects complete DMI/free/meminfo/NUMA evidence.
manual_activity: Qualified operator establishes the approved full-memory population with power removed and captures POST/BIOS; agent may collect read-only Linux evidence after safe boot.
required_inputs: Exact CPU/board/DIMM full-population channel-slot map and capacity/speed/ECC specification
Qualified operator, power-off/ESD service procedure and KVM
Accounting tolerance, ECC/SEL/thermal abort and restoration/recovery policy
safety_requirements: Remove power and follow qualified ESD/service procedure before DIMM changes
Do not hot-plug or use an unapproved population
Use secure authenticated host-verified OS access
Stop on no-POST, wrong slot map, ECC/SEL/thermal error or unstable boot
No automatic reseat, BIOS change, reboot or recovery
agent_execution_scope: After operator-confirmed full-population boot, collect complete DMI/free/meminfo/NUMA and health evidence
Compare every populated/empty slot, capacity and accounting to supplied full map
Do not manipulate DIMMs/power/BIOS, infer POST from OS or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Provide and approve exact full-population components, topology and accounting criteria
Control safe physical setup and any restoration
Review POST/BIOS/OS evidence and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DMI/free are supporting evidence only; unsafe SSH and absence of physical setup, POST/BIOS and full slot/accounting coverage make the proposal incomplete.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After qualified full-population setup and BIOS capture, securely collect unfiltered `dmidecode -t memory`, `free`, meminfo and NUMA/topology.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Full memory, power-on, slot correctness and20/25 fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind every physical slot/module to the signed full-population map, capture training/POST and BIOS, then reconcile complete OS inventory and capacity.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds controlled hardware lifecycle, configuration identity, secure evidence and explicit failure recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: OS output alone cannot establish that the intended full population was installed or that POST completed normally.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Maximum population stresses training, channel balance, power and thermals; Linux usable capacity is normally below installed capacity.

project_override_considerations: Project must define what full means for the exact platform, boot deadline, speed/down-training rule and installed-versus-usable tolerance; no absent slot is assumed optional.
expected_evidence: Approved full channel-slot population map and service record
Complete DMI/free/meminfo/NUMA including every populated/empty slot
Installed-versus-usable memory reconciliation and trained speed

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master title, procedure and criteria consistently require full-memory power-on and correct slot information. Exact topology and accounting rules are project readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operator, full-population map, tools and recovery plan can be supplied; manual setup is a prerequisite, not an inherent block.

review_improvement: Prevents post-boot DMI/free output from replacing the defining full-memory installation, POST and BIOS evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A fully populated memory subsystem exercises the maximum number of channels, ranks and electrical loads, so successful Linux enumeration does not by itself prove every expected module trained or that early-boot warnings were absent. Slot-level BIOS/POST evidence must be joined to complete OS inventory and capacity accounting.
